Further Away than Love, Closer than Hatred

description:
Residing in the house of the enemy who destroyed her family, Raina is held captive like a trophy by his successor, Kaylid. Once a source of comfort to each other, now only hatred and obsession remain between the two. One day, Raina discovers Zepion, a young boy who is the last survivor of a clan exterminated by Kaylid. 

Raina takes him in, deciding to raise him into the blade that will complete her revenge. She didn't care even if he grew up to hate her. However, the closer Zepion gets, the deeper Kaylid's obsession grows, and Raina herself begins to waver in emotions she believed were over. The time she endured just to kill him. 

At the end of it all, why did I become afraid of losing you?
